wedding.invitationSubtitle: Two souls, one destiny. We invite you to celebrate our union.
wedding.heroQuote: In the quiet rhythm of our laughter and in every shared dream, we found our forever.
wedding.introText: With grateful hearts and the blessings of our elders, we invite you to join us on our most cherished journey.
wedding.closingMessage: Your love and presence have enriched our lives. We cannot wait to celebrate this milestone together.

story.title: The First Hello
story.description: A chance conversation in a rain-kissed bookstore cafe in Bombay. What was supposed to be a fleeting coffee turned into four hours of discovering shared dreams and favorite verses.

story.title: The Golden Hour Journey
story.description: From spontaneous weekend road trips along the Konkan coast to supporting each other through quiet milestones, our paths intertwined until everyday life felt incomplete without each other.

story.title: The Forever Promise
story.description: Under a canopy of starlight in Udaipur, with the serene waters of Lake Pichola murmuring beside us, a quiet question was whispered — and answered with tears and boundless joy.

venue.name: The Leela Palace Udaipur
venue.description: Nestled along the pristine banks of Lake Pichola, The Leela Palace stands as a breathtaking jewel of Mewari architecture. Flanked by the rolling Aravalli Hills and historic City Palace, its regal courtyards, glistening marble corridors, and open terraces offer an ethereal backdrop for our celebration.
venue.airportInfo: Maharana Pratap Airport (UDR) is 26 km (approx. 45 mins) from the venue. Private chauffeur transfers will be arranged for out-of-town guests.
venue.accommodations: Guest accommodations have been reserved at The Leela Palace and Trident Hotel. Our hospitality desk is available 24/7 to assist with your arrival.

family.blessingQuote: With the loving memories of our cherished grandparents and the warmest blessings of all our uncles, aunts, and siblings.
family.additionalNote: We look forward to welcoming you and celebrating this sacred step in our family's story.
